title: Isomorphism descent through exact derived open restriction
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $U$ an open subscheme, and choose derived module categories [def-pc-derived-category] with Hom universe $w$ on $X$ and $U$. Put $R=(\operatorname{schemeOpenRestriction} X U).\operatorname{mapDerivedCategory}$, the exact derived open restriction of [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Let $E$ be any category and let $F,G:D(\mathcal O_U)\to E$ be functors. For every natural isomorphism $\alpha:F\circ R\cong G\circ R$, there exists a natural isomorphism $\beta:F\cong G$ whose precomposition with $R$ is exactly $\alpha$. No nonemptiness or strict inclusion condition is imposed on $U$.

source.place: cohomology.tex, lemma-adjoint-lower-shriek-restrict; agent-written formal localization expansion

proof.text: Apply schemeDerivedOpenRestriction_isLocalization to X and U. Precomposition with this localization is fully faithful by Localization.fullyFaithfulWhiskeringLeft. Its preimageIso applied to alpha gives beta. Evaluate map_preimage alpha.hom componentwise and use isomorphism extensionality to obtain the exact whiskering equality. Empty and whole opens require no separate hypotheses.

lean.statement:
theorem derived_open_restriction_iso_descent
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    {E : Type z} [Category.{v} E]
    (F G : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme ⥤ E)
    (alpha : (schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ F ≅
      (schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ G) :
    ∃ beta : F ≅ G,
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory beta = alpha
